title: Compliance Memorandum: Units Listed on a Plan Member Waiver, Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program
content:
# Units a plan member waiver lists

Compliance Memorandum on Liability Notices, Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program.

A plan member waiver is the liability notice of a commercial tier of the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program. This memorandum states which units of the next delivery of the CGM supply allowance (A4239) the waiver lists, the units at risk being the units of the delivery's 30-day blocks the payer is expected not to pay.

## Terms

- The delivery's units are the units it carries; the latest refill is the refill shipment of the item on the program with the latest ship date.
- Continued use is confirmed for a refill when the refill carries a refill confirmation date, the date the customer confirmed continued use and supply on hand.

## The rule

The listing adjustment replaces what the waiver lists, the first of these rules that applies governing:

1. When the delivery draws on a grant other than the one the latest refill drew on and the payer authorization has fewer units left than the delivery carries, the waiver lists the units at risk and the units beyond the payer authorization, never more than the delivery's units.
2. When refills of the item are on record but the latest carries no refill confirmation date, so continued use is not confirmed, the waiver lists every unit of the delivery.
3. Otherwise the standard listing applies: the waiver lists the units at risk.

## Points of judgement

| Records show | Units listed |
|---|---|
| Delivery's grant differs from the latest refill's grant, and that grant's units left are fewer than the delivery's units | units at risk together with the units beyond the payer authorization, capped at the delivery's units |
| Rule 1 not met; latest refill has no refill confirmation date | every unit of the delivery |
| Rule 1 not met; latest refill carries a refill confirmation date, or no refill of the item is on record | the units at risk (the standard listing) |

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

Take a hypothetical delivery of 3 units drawing on a new grant, with 1 unit at risk.

- The latest refill's grant has 1 unit left: 2 units lie beyond the payer authorization; 1 at risk plus 2 beyond is 3, which does not exceed the delivery, so the waiver lists 3 units.
- With 2 units at risk and the same 1 unit left: 2 at risk plus 2 beyond is 4, capped at the delivery's 3 units.
- The latest refill's grant has 5 units left: rule 1 is not met; if the latest refill carries a refill confirmation date the waiver lists the 1 unit at risk, and if it carries none the waiver lists all 3 units.
- The delivery draws on the same grant the latest refill drew on: rule 1 is not met whatever units are left.
